prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: six-frame overhead RTS character running cycle sprite atlas.
Input image 1 is the approved bronze mace warrior design, input image 2 is approved idle sprite scale and top-down viewpoint reference.
Create a RUNNING animation sheet for exactly this same warrior with the same equipment, proportions, colours, stylized painted linework: circular domed bronze helmet with rim and rivets, paired bronze pauldrons, thick cream fur collar, red leather sleeves, brown footwear, rounded lobed bronze mace held in his right hand (screen LEFT), wood round shield with bronze rim in left hand (screen RIGHT).
Output exactly1536x1024 PNG with true transparent alpha, 3 columns by2 rows, each512x512 cell contains one frame, chronological left-right top-bottom. No grid lines or labels. Each helmet crown center near x256 y245 within its cell; central dome diameter90-100pixels; constant scale and fixed camera. Leave generous transparent guard space.
Camera is STRICTLY NADIR vertical orthographic overhead as the reference. View the top of helmet and shoulders; shoulders and helmet overlap most of torso; never reveal face, chest portrait, front-facing legs, sloping camera, isometric angle.
Run facing SCREEN DOWN, six phases of a continuous vigorous running stride: 1 right foot extends forward toward bottom while left foot trails toward top; 2 right foot pushes off and left advances; 3 left foot passes beneath hips; 4 left foot extends toward bottom while right trails; 5 left foot pushes off and right advances; 6 right foot passes beneath hips and joins frame1. Feet must alternate visibly beyond body silhouette but show top planes, no frontal shins. Opposite shoulders subtly rotate and elbows naturally counter-swing close to body. Mace always in same anatomical hand, restrained diagonal carry with rounded mace head, shield carried edge-oblique overhead like reference, not a huge forward facing circle. Preserve natural elbow bend, no backwards or dislocated arms. Helmet and shoulder proportions remain stable, mild body lean represented by overlap, no zoom. Distinct poses and a seamless cycle.
Lighting: clear painted shapes matching reference, no photorealistic texture. Absolutely transparent empty background, no haze, red glow, floor, shadow wash or backdrop. No extra items, no axe, no watermark.
